contest: Most members: at round end, whoever has the most members wins it (+4 followers in round I, +6 in round II, +10 in round III).

story.line: Blue bends the shop: clear it out, see what's coming, then buy a bunch in one turn (Cory, Oct 17: "rearrange the shop and then buy a bunch").
story.greatGame: Round I: take Out of Style ("Send every shop member of one color to the discard pile, then refill. +1 blue per member sent. +1 blue.") to wipe the color a rival wanted and bank 4 blue, and pick up Last-Minute Shopper ("Round End: +3 blue, then you may recruit.") so every round ends with a free extra recruit. Round II: Power Shoppers ("Whenever you recruit your second member in a turn, +4 followers.") plus Recruit Twice ("Recruit an extra time this turn. +3 blue.") makes a two-member turn worth +4 followers on top, and Mannequin ("Blue members in the shop count as your members when contests are scored.") pushes you toward Most members. Round III: Spree ("Recruit two extra times this turn. +6 blue.") is the big shopping turn and the Most members contest pays +10. Rivals answer by taking Recruit Twice or Spree first, buying the blue members out of the shop to shrink Mannequin, and clearing the row before you buy.
freshStart: Space, round I, Rummage: "Recruit the top member of the discard pile instead of a shop member this turn. +3 blue in round I, +4 in round II, +5 in round III." (Claude's fill-in)
Space, round II, Pick of the Row: "Send any shop members to the discard pile, then refill. Recruit an extra time this turn. +2 blue." (Claude's fill-in)
Space, round III, Buyout: "Recruit every shop member of one color, paying each one's cost. +3 blue." (Claude's fill-in)
Member, Pickers [3 blue + 3 any, worth 1]: "On Use, once per round: recruit the top member of the discard pile, paying its cost." (Claude's fill-in)
Member, Bulk Buyers [4 blue + 4 any, worth 2, counts as 2]: "Whenever you recruit your third member in a turn, +6 followers." (Claude's fill-in)

cards.name: Savings
cards.text: +2 blue in round I, +3 in round II, +4 in round III. Before you recruit, you may send one shop member to the discard pile, then refill.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: I'm last to place before the player who needs one 10-cost member. I take Savings, +4 blue, discard that member before my recruit, and with the Blue Cloak ("Whenever you discard a member, +1 of its color (grey: any color).") I get +1 of its color.
cards.topCase: Round III with the Blue Cloak and Patroness ("Whenever shop members go to the discard pile, +1 follower."): +4 blue, +1 resource, +1 follower, about 6. Best round III spaces pay 10 or more (Spree's two extra recruits, Initiation's free member up to 10). Doesn't break anything.
cards.ideaWhy: Income plus one small shop nudge; the discard is the same move Blue already makes on four other cards.
cards.ties: Feeds the Blue Cloak and Patroness, and can pull a card a rival (or Red's Promote, Initiation) was going to take.
cards.why: His pick and a solid income space; the discard is a small extra, no big moment.
cards.short: Round III: +4 blue and bin the 10-cost member a rival needed.
cards.risk: Overlaps Bury: both send one shop member away.

cards.name: Out of Style
cards.text: Send every shop member of one color to the discard pile, then refill. +1 blue per member sent. +1 blue.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, 4 players, 7 in the shop: three are yellow and the Yellow player is next. I send all three: +4 blue, +3 yellow from the Blue Cloak, and the Yellow player's plan for the turn is gone.
cards.topCase: Round III, 8 in the shop, 3 of one color, Blue Cloak and Patroness: +4 blue, +3 resources, +1 follower, about 8, plus the denial. Near the best round III spaces from a round I slot, but it needs the shop to line up; not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: One move, one rule: clear a color, get paid per card.
cards.ties: The strongest sting in Blue: empties the color a rival collects and also clears blue members out from under a rival's Mannequin.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 28: "it should still be per member sent. it's actually rather good that way".
cards.why: He called it rather good, and it is Blue's one real sting on rivals.
cards.short: Round II: clear 3 yellow from the shop, +4 blue, ruin Yellow's turn.

cards.name: Peek
cards.text: Look at the top 4 of the pile and put them back in any order. This turn your recruit may be one of them. +3 blue in round I, +4 in round II, +5 in round III.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: the shop has nothing I want. I peek, find Power Shoppers fourth from the top, recruit it, and put a weak card on top so the next refill gives rivals nothing. +4 blue.
cards.topCase: Round III: +5 blue and a pick of 4 extra members, about 5 plus a better recruit. Below the best round III spaces; never breaks.
cards.ideaWhy: Look ahead and choose from what's coming; the reorder and the recruit are one idea.
cards.ties: Stacks the pile that Red's Walk-In draws from and that every refill deals to rivals.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 27: Peek "should really scale" (it now does). Oct 27: "Peek UI is unintuitive" (screen, since reworked).
cards.why: A good quiet turn with a hidden choice; nobody at the table reacts much.
cards.short: Round II: pick Power Shoppers from 4 hidden cards, +4 blue.

cards.name: Recruit Twice
cards.text: Recruit an extra time this turn. +3 blue.
cards.bestTurn: Round II with 12 resources: I take two members on one turn, and with Power Shoppers that's +4 followers on top, +3 blue back.
cards.topCase: Round III, rich: two 10-follower buys in one turn is +20 followers against about 10 from the best single space; that needs 20 resources saved, so it is the payoff of saving, not free. Fine at the top.
cards.ideaWhy: One extra recruit; nothing else to remember.
cards.ties: Turns saved resources from any color into members or followers; Power Shoppers and the Blue contest (Most members) build on it.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1 1:29pm: stays as is, "I feel like the bots are probably using it incorrectly… it can be a 20 follower swing." Nov 6: Recruit Twice stays.
cards.why: He defended it twice; the double-buy turn is Blue's signature moment.
cards.short: Round II: two members in one turn, +4 followers from Power Shoppers.
cards.risk: Overlaps Plus-Ones: same extra recruit as a member.

cards.name: Bury
cards.text: Send a shop member to the discard pile, then refill. Gain blue equal to half its cost, rounded down. +1 blue.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: a 10-cost member a rival was saving for sits in the shop. I bury it: +5 blue, +1 blue, +1 of its color from the Blue Cloak.
cards.topCase: Round III, 10-cost card, Blue Cloak and Patroness: +6 blue, +1 resource, +1 follower, about 8. Beside Recruit Twice in the same ring it is the smaller turn.
cards.ideaWhy: Cost math (half its cost, rounded down), and the discard twin of Savings and Out of Style.
cards.ties: Same reach as Savings: pulls one card a rival wanted and feeds the Cloak and Patroness.
cards.coryNotes: None on the live card. Its full-cost version was turned down Oct 20: "way too strong. it would be like +10 blue in round 2".
cards.why: Blue's third one-card discard, with a halving sum; the space you'd miss least.
cards.short: Round II: bury a rival's 10-cost target, +6 blue.
cards.risk: Overlaps Savings: both discard one shop member.

cards.name: Spree
cards.text: Recruit two extra times this turn. +6 blue.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: I've saved 18 resources. Three recruits in one turn: two members and a follower card, Power Shoppers adds +4 followers, and Blue's Most members contest swings to me.
cards.topCase: Three 10-follower buys is +30, but it needs 30 resources. With a realistic 20 saved plus Spree's 6: about +24 to 26 followers, against about 10 from Initiation ("Recruit a member in the shop costing 10 or less, for free. +1 red."). Big, but paid for by saving all game.
cards.ideaWhy: Recruit Twice, bigger, at the end; the color's finish.
cards.ties: Gives every player a reason to save resources for round III and to take it first.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 29: "I still don't think this is weak". Nov 1: "just up the blue gain to +3 and +5"; Nov 5: +6 blue.
cards.why: His defended payoff space; the biggest turn Blue can build to.
cards.short: Round III: three recruits in one turn, about +25 followers.
cards.risk: Overlaps Recruit Twice: same card, bigger.

cards.name: Bargain Bin (the Blue Cloak)
cards.text: Whenever you discard a member, +1 of its color (grey: any color).
cards.bestTurn: Round II: Out of Style on a shop with 3 yellow: +3 yellow from the cloak on top of +4 blue.
cards.topCase: About 10 resources a game for the holder in testing, Cory's target 10 to 12. One turn of Window Dressers plus Out of Style can pay 6 to 7. Not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: One trigger, one gain, from your own actions.
cards.ties: Makes every Blue discard card better and pays in other colors, so Blue can buy any color's members.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 7 11:28am: "Just give one color of the member discarded PER EACH DISCARDED. greys are wild".
cards.why: His fresh wording, at his target; quiet but ties the color together.
cards.short: Out of Style on 3 yellow: +3 yellow on top of +4 blue.

cards.name: Patroness
cards.text: Whenever shop members go to the discard pile, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: three rivals each discard from the shop this round and the shop is cleared between rounds: +4 followers without lifting a finger.
cards.topCase: Bought in round II, every discard and the two round changes: about 8 to 10 followers by game end for a 10-resource card worth 1. Roughly a follower card bought slowly; no moment.
cards.ideaWhy: Simple trigger, but it pays on rivals' turns, the passive gain he took out of the cloaks.
cards.ties: Rewards every player's discards, Blue's and White's alike, without anyone deciding anything.
cards.why: The priciest blue member for a slow drip of followers that mostly comes from rivals' turns.
cards.short: About +8 to 10 followers over a game from shop discards.
cards.risk: Overlaps Bargain Bin: both paid by discards.

cards.name: Snobs
cards.text: Game End: +1 follower per blue member you have.
cards.bestTurn: Game end: five blue members including Snobs' own 2: +6 followers on top of its worth 2.
cards.topCase: Built around it, 6 to 7 blue members counted: about +7 at game end. Under a round III space; never breaks.
cards.ideaWhy: Collect blue, get paid at the end; plain set collection.
cards.ties: Pushes Blue to buy its own color, which also feeds Mannequin and the Most members contest.
cards.why: Clear and on theme for Most members, but the payoff is a number at the end, never a turn.
cards.short: Game end with 5 blue members: +6 followers.

cards.name: Power Shoppers
cards.text: Whenever you recruit your second member in a turn, +4 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III Spree: my second member lands and Power Shoppers pays +4 followers on top of the members.
cards.topCase: Once per turn at most: round II Recruit Twice, round III Spree, plus a Plus-Ones turn: about +8 to 12 a game. Strong, not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Rewards Blue's own move, two members in a turn.
cards.ties: Makes Recruit Twice and Spree worth fighting over; rivals take those spaces partly to shut it off.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 5: "i actually do like power shoppers". Nov 6: yes to +4.
cards.why: He likes it, and it turns Blue's double-buy into a visible payoff.
cards.short: Round III Spree: second member lands, +4 followers.

cards.name: Mannequin
cards.text: Blue members in the shop count as your members when contests are scored.
cards.bestTurn: Round III end: I'm one member behind on Most members, but 3 blue members sit in the shop. I win the contest, +10.
cards.topCase: Round III shop with 2 to 4 blue: wins or ties Most members, worth the +10 prize. Rivals can buy or clear those cards, so it's a race, not a lock.
cards.ideaWhy: One surprising rule that reads straight off the table.
cards.ties: Gives rivals a reason to buy blue or take Out of Style late in the round; its own owner wants Out of Style off blue.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 4: "Pretty cool; short list for blue".
cards.why: He picked it, and it makes the end of every round a fight over the shop.
cards.short: Round III: 3 blue shop members win Most members, +10 followers.

cards.name: Window Shopper
cards.text: On Recruit and at Round Start: send 2 shop members to the discard pile. +1 of each one's color.
cards.bestTurn: Recruited in round I: +2 resources now, +2 at each later Round Start, and with the Blue Cloak twice that.
cards.topCase: Recruited round I: 3 fires, 6 resources, 12 with the Cloak, plus Patroness ticks. About a follower card's worth over the game; not broken.
cards.ties: Changes the first shop rivals see each round and pays in other colors.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 1 1:40pm: moves 2 members, "so then you get 2 colors basically".
cards.why: His shape and steady, but no one at the table notices it fire.
cards.short: Recruited round I: 6 resources over the game, 12 with the Blue Cloak.
cards.risk: Overlaps Window Dressers: both clear the shop on recruit.

cards.name: Restockers
cards.price: [3 blue + 3 any, worth 2, counts as 2] (15-card deck only)
cards.text: On Use, once per game: send the whole shop to the discard pile, then refill.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: the rival before me left a 10-cost they'd saved for. I clear all 8; with the Blue Cloak, +8 resources.
cards.topCase: Round III, 8 members, Cloak and Patroness: +8 resources and +1 follower once, about 9. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Clear everything once; but it's Out of Style without the color choice.
cards.ties: Wipes the shop for everyone, including what Red and Yellow were aiming at.
cards.why: Not in the 10-card deck, and a twin of Out of Style and Window Dressers.
cards.short: Round III: clear all 8 shop members, +8 resources with the Blue Cloak.
cards.risk: Overlaps Out of Style: both clear the shop.

cards.name: Window Dressers
cards.text: On Recruit: send 3 shop members to the discard pile, then refill.
cards.bestTurn: Round I: 5 resources buys 3 followers and 3 members toward Most members, and I clear 3 cards (+3 resources with the Cloak).
cards.topCase: Mostly its body: worth 3 and counts as 3 for 5 resources. The clear is +3 with the Cloak once. Strong price, small moment.
cards.ideaWhy: A cheap crowd with a one-time clear; the clear is a third twin.
cards.ties: Helps Blue's Most members contest a lot; the clear can rob a rival of a card.
cards.why: Players buy it for the 3 members, not the clear; a reworded version did not beat it.
cards.short: Round I: 5 resources buys 3 followers and counts as 3 members.
cards.risk: Overlaps Window Shopper: both clear the shop on recruit.

cards.name: Plus-Ones
cards.price: [3 blue + 3 any, worth 2, counts as 2] (15-card deck only)
cards.text: On Recruit: recruit again this turn.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: I recruit Plus-Ones, then recruit again: two members in a turn, so Power Shoppers pays +4.
cards.topCase: Once: a free extra recruit plus 2 members' worth for 6. Never breaks.
cards.ideaWhy: It pays for its own recruit; a member copy of Recruit Twice.
cards.ties: Sets off Power Shoppers without the space.
cards.why: Clean and useful with Power Shoppers, but not in the 10-card deck and a twin of Recruit Twice.
cards.short: Round II: recruit twice in one turn, Power Shoppers pays +4.
cards.risk: Overlaps Recruit Twice: same extra recruit.

cards.name: Regular
cards.bestTurn: Round III: three follower buys over the round, +3 blue.
cards.topCase: Built around buying followers every turn from round I: maybe +8 blue a game. Small.
cards.ideaWhy: About buying followers, which is White's job (White Cloak: "Whenever you buy followers, +2 white."), not the shop.
cards.ties: Same trigger as White's cloak; nothing here touches the shop or members.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 26, on a White option that copied it: "we don't have something here already?"
cards.why: Small drip on another color's trigger; the blue member you'd miss least.
cards.short: Round III: three follower buys, +3 blue.
cards.risk: Overlaps White's Money Changers: both pay on follower buys.

cards.name: Trendsetters
cards.text: Whenever you recruit a member, send 1 shop member to the discard pile, then refill.
cards.bestTurn: Round III Spree: three members in, three cards cleared, +3 resources from the Cloak and the cards rivals wanted gone.
cards.topCase: About 5 to 8 discards a game, each +1 with the Cloak and a Patroness tick, plus 3 members for 6. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Every buy clears one; but it's the fourth discard card.
cards.ties: Keeps rivals from counting on the shop staying put after your turn.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Oct 21: made Trendsetter Blue's 12th member.
cards.why: His pick and a good crowd for Most members; the ability blurs into the other discards.
cards.short: Round III Spree: three members in, three shop cards gone.

cards.name: Critic
cards.text: Whenever a rival recruits a blue member, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: A rival buys two blue members in round II: +2 followers.
cards.topCase: Depends on rivals buying blue: maybe +3 to 5 a game. Nobody can build around it.
cards.ideaWhy: Simple, but pays only on rivals' choices.
cards.ties: Taxes rivals buying blue lightly, so lightly nobody changes a buy.
cards.why: A small passive gain from other players' turns; no one at the table feels it.
cards.short: A rival buys two blue members in round II: +2 followers.

cards.name: Last-Minute Shopper
cards.text: Round End: +3 blue, then you may recruit.
cards.bestTurn: Round II end: +3 blue, then I buy the member that tips Most members before contests are scored.
cards.topCase: Recruited in round I: three round ends, +9 blue and three extra recruits; the round III one can be a 10-follower card. About +15 over a game. Strong, not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: The name says it: one more buy, at the last minute.
cards.ties: Lands right before contests, so it can swing Most members or any contest that counts members.
cards.coryNotes: Cory, Nov 5: "Last minute shopper is good." "Last Minute Shopper should just be recruiting." Nov 6: "Give last minute shopper an extra blue".
cards.why: He called it good and tuned it up; a real end-of-round moment.
cards.short: Round II end: +3 blue, then buy the member that wins Most members.

overlaps: Extra recruits, four cards: Recruit Twice "Recruit an extra time this turn. +3 blue.", Spree "Recruit two extra times this turn. +6 blue.", Plus-Ones "On Recruit: recruit again this turn.", Last-Minute Shopper "Round End: +3 blue, then you may recruit." Spree is Recruit Twice bigger; Plus-Ones is Recruit Twice as a member.

One-card discard: Savings "...Before you recruit, you may send one shop member to the discard pile, then refill." and Bury "Send a shop member to the discard pile, then refill. Gain blue equal to half its cost, rounded down. +1 blue."

Clear many: Out of Style "Send every shop member of one color to the discard pile, then refill. +1 blue per member sent. +1 blue.", Restockers "On Use, once per game: send the whole shop to the discard pile, then refill.", Window Dressers "On Recruit: send 3 shop members to the discard pile, then refill.", Window Shopper "On Recruit and at Round Start: send 2 shop members to the discard pile. +1 of each one's color.", Trendsetters "Whenever you recruit a member, send 1 shop member to the discard pile, then refill."
Paid by discards: Bargain Bin "Whenever you discard a member, +1 of its color (grey: any color)." and Patroness "Whenever shop members go to the discard pile, +1 follower."
With White: Regular "Whenever you buy followers, +1 blue." and the White Cloak "Whenever you buy followers, +2 white."
notes: Blue has two jobs, clearing the shop and buying more than once a turn, and the second one has all the big moments (Recruit Twice, Spree, Power Shoppers, Last-Minute Shopper). Seven cards clear the shop in slightly different ways, so the clearing half blurs; the weak cards (Bury, Patroness, Regular, Critic, Restockers) are mostly small drips or twins. Blue's only real sting on rivals is Out of Style, and Mannequin is its only card that makes the end of a round a fight. Restockers and Plus-Ones are only in the 15-card deck.
storyShort: Blue clears the shop, sees what's coming, then buys a bunch in one turn.
